name: cordapoint-drafting
description: Sends drafting work to Gemini: emails, posts, translations, rewrites and summaries. Claude writes the prompt with placeholders, calls the Gemini tool, then checks and fixes each draft and says which Gemini model wrote it. Public text only: no personal data, secrets, or confidential business details.

gemini_api_key.title: Gemini API key
gemini_api_key.description: Your Google Gemini API key. Stored in your system's secure credential store, never in a settings file.
